physics.radial_baseline: algebraic MOND approximation on published SPARC baryonic force templates; not a full-field disk solution
physics.formulation_control: AQUAL is distinct and requires separate validation

radial_selection.rule: Retain all source rows; score only finite positive radius, observed speed, error and total inward baryonic force. Apply galaxy quality/inclination cuts without consulting residuals. No cut on observed fractional velocity error.
radial_selection.distance_and_inclination_sensitivity: nominal and reported plus/minus one-error corners; sensitivity envelope, not a confidence interval
radial_selection.covariance: published per-radius errors available, full radial covariance absent: descriptive errors only, no chi-square significance

catalog.identity_rule: Normalize only recognized NGC/IC/UGC/DDO numeric names and explicit aliases. Strong catalog IDs merge exactly. Proximity creates review candidates, never automatic identity merges.
catalog.missing_data: Unknown, absent local asset, published nondetection, invalid profile and measured zero are distinct statuses.
catalog.old_holdouts: Preserve documented WALLABY reserved identities; do not read their velocities for this milestone. Prior exposure elsewhere remains unknown unless audited.
catalog.manga_predictors: Allowlisted photometry, structure and observed HI only; no imported halo masses, dynamical masses or environment acceleration proxies.

pattern_analysis.split: 5 whole-galaxy folds fixed by sha256 identity; not pristine confirmation
pattern_analysis.target: median log10(observed speed / fixed algebraic MOND predicted speed) per galaxy
pattern_analysis.control: Nested training-only ridge choice; compare acceleration-only predictors with acceleration plus one descriptor. Permute descriptor labels and repeat entire outer-validation pipeline. No density-causation claim.
